title: 第1章  合欢宗的百年老鼎！
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
“诸位同门，接下来是本次拍卖会的压轴大戏——先天纯阳圣体！”
合欢宗地下黑市。
拍卖师歇斯底里的声音，在空旷的会场上空回荡。
“千年难遇！无上大药！”
“得此炉鼎，一夜破境，如饮甘泉！”
台下，无数合欢宗妖女眼神狂热。
数十道如狼似虎的神识，迫不及待地扫向那被厚重黑布遮掩的巨大铁笼。
“别废话！快掀开！”
“让老娘看看是何等水灵的少年郎！”
拍卖师嘴角一勾，猛地扯下黑布。
各种术法制作的光线瞬间砸在铁笼上。
下一秒，全场陡然一静。
铁笼里，根本没有鲜衣怒马的少年郎。
只有一个须发皆白、满脸老年斑、身形佝偻的老头。
他正站在原地颤颤巍巍，仿佛一阵阴风吹过，就能当场圆寂。
铁笼中，李寒山脸色木然。
“苍天啊，别人穿越都是俊美无双，凭什么让我穿成个百岁老登？”
刚穿过来，半截身子都已经埋进了黄土。
本以为这辈子就这么完了，谁知更倒霉的还在后头——他竟被丧心病狂的合欢宗抓来当了炉鼎。
完蛋了。

他听其他被抓的人说过，合欢宗的炉鼎，最后都会被活生生吸成人干。
李寒山低头看了看自己枯树皮一样的手，在心底干笑两声。
唯一值得庆幸的是，这帮如狼似虎的合欢宗妖女，应该不愿意啃自己这根老葱吧？
然而，短暂的死寂后。
台下突然爆发出一阵掀翻屋顶的喧哗！
“天呐！竟然是活到了百岁、元阳未泄的老翁！”
一个身材火辣的红衣妖女双眼猩红，猛地站起身，声音都在发抖。
“老蚌生珠，越老越醇！不敢想他体内的纯阳之气已经沉淀到了何等恐怖的地步！”
另一个美艳少妇推开男宠，舔了舔猩红的嘴唇，目光贪婪得像是在看一块绝世珍宝。
“这老头归老娘了！我出一百灵石！”
“五百灵石！老娘要了！”
“放屁！五百就想买绝品人材？我出一千！”
“两千！谁敢跟我抢，出了黑市我杀谁！”
全疯了。
这群妖女双眼猩红，看着李寒山仿佛在看一盘绝世美味。
哪怕他已经皮包骨头，她们也恨不得立刻扑上来生吞活剥。
李寒山麻了。
他本以为老得掉渣能逃过一劫，谁知道这群女魔头根本不忌口！
“一万灵石。”
就在台下争得快要拔剑杀人时，一道娇媚入骨的声音，在会场骤然炸响。

妖女们看清说话人，纷纷变色。
纵有万般不甘，也只能乖乖低头退让，连个屁都不敢放。
李寒山循着声音抬头。
却在看清买主的瞬间，连魂都快被勾走了。
来人腰若柔柳，肌肤胜雪，朱唇似火。
此刻，她正慵懒地倚在二楼栏杆上，葱白的手指夹着一根长柄烟杆。
那张倾国倾城的绝世容颜上流转着风情万种的媚意，朱唇轻吐烟气，眼中波光流转，能让天下男人为之疯狂。
合欢宗内门天骄，花弄影。
从旁人噤若寒蝉的反应中，李寒山迅速捕捉到了这个女人的可怕地位。
拍卖师满脸的狰狞瞬间化作谄媚：“原来是花师姐！师姐能看上这老鼎，是他的造化！”
花弄影不咸不淡地“嗯”了一声，足尖轻点，如柳絮般从二楼飘落至铁笼前。
她微微俯身，用微凉的烟杆挑起李寒山的下巴，娇媚一笑：
“这老东西，本仙子要了~”
语气轻佻得像是在挑一件有趣的小玩意儿。
说罢，她丢出一袋灵石，玉手轻扬，一条白绫自袖中飞出，将李寒山捆了个结实。
随后她腾空而起，像拎小鸡仔一样将李寒山拽上半空。
“卧槽......慢点！老头子我骨质疏松啊！”
风中，李寒山欲哭无泪，感觉自己全身的骨头都在咯吱作响。
片刻后。
两人落入一处古色古香的幽静院落。

房门推开，粉红罗帐层层叠叠，一股甜腻入骨的幽香扑面而来。
端的是一处销魂的温柔乡。
然而，李寒山被扔在软榻上的瞬间，浑身血液却凝固了。
他的目光死死盯着大床角落。
那里，赫然躺着一具被吸成干尸的男尸！双眼暴突，死状极惨！
真吸成干啊！
这妖女花大价钱买下他，绝对是要把他敲骨吸髓！
“仙、仙子，强扭的瓜不甜，我都一百岁了……”
李寒山疯狂往后缩。
“怎么，难道你不想么？”
花弄影媚眼如丝，身形跟着往前凑了几分。
她挨得太近，李寒山甚至能清晰地闻到那股散发着奇异甜香的烟气，丝丝缕缕地直往鼻子里钻，让李寒山险些压不住老兄弟。
“不要！”
李寒山屏住呼吸，强压下心头躁动，让自己冷静下来。
“呵。”
眼见李寒山还能挺住，花弄影眉头微挑。
她俯身凑近李寒山，香舌带着一丝微凉的湿意，轻轻在他耳垂下舔过。
这个极具挑逗的动作，瞬间将李寒山的欲望推到了顶点！
“别怕，很舒服的。”
花弄影的微哑烟嗓的慵懒撩人，内容却令人寒彻骨髓：

“外头那些蠢货只知道硬来，却不知怎么用，纯阳之气可以助我修成镇宗大法，等你断了气，躯壳还能炼成人丹。
“以奴家的手段，定让老伯在人世极乐中，羽化登仙呢~”
李寒山如遭雷击。
连尸体都不放过？！这女人是纯纯的魔鬼！
花弄影拍了拍手，招来两名婢女。
“带他去洗干净。”
“太虚不受补，每日三次药浴，药量逐次增加三成，给本仙子伺候好了~”
“先给我吊住他这口先天纯阳之气，没有我的命令，不许他死。”
接下来的十五天。
李寒山彻底成了一个被圈养的药人。
每天除了吃喝拉撒，就是泡在冒着浓郁药香的木桶里。
修仙界的灵药极为霸道。
短短半个月，他干瘪的身体竟奇迹般地生出几分气血，脸颊饱满了起来，连皱纹都淡了不少。
枯木逢春？
李寒山笑不出来。
他很清楚，这是杀猪前的催肥。喂得越饱，死得越惨。
直到第十五天深夜。
“轰！”
里间突然爆发出一股狂暴的灵力波动！
房门被炸得粉碎，李寒山被气浪掀翻在地，摔得七荤八素。

“该死！又失败了！”
“不修成洛祖师的无上秘法，我拿什么去和那些婊子争？！”
她双目赤红，气息紊乱，眼中透着走火入魔般的癫狂。
她的目光，死死锁定在角落里惊魂未定的李寒山身上。
身形如电，瞬间欺身而上！
花弄影一把捏开李寒山的下巴，屈指一弹。
一枚通体赤红、散发着狂暴热力的丹药，直直射入他喉咙。
“吃下它！三日后，与我双修！”
“仙子，我还能再养养……”李寒山大骇。
“闭嘴！再废话我现在就抽干你！”
花弄影根本不给他拒绝的机会，拂袖而去，关死了房门。
丹药入腹的瞬间。
轰——！
李寒山只觉五脏六腑如同被浇了滚烫的岩浆，万千钢针在经脉里疯狂穿刺！
“啊——！”
他痛苦地蜷缩在地，浑身青筋暴起，剧烈抽搐。
那种将灵魂都要撕裂的剧痛，将他的理智吞没。
最终，在无尽的折磨中，李寒山彻底昏死了过去。
不知过了多久。
“哗啦啦……”

耳边，传来清脆的流水声。
意识渐渐复苏，李寒山猛地睁开眼。
他又进入了那个神秘的梦境。
抬头望去。
却见一个白衣胜雪的少女，正坐在河边的青石上，轻轻晃动着白皙晶莹的小腿。
她衣衫半敞，一只小手捂在光裸紧实的小腹上，出神地遥望着天际。
听到动静，少女如受惊的小鹿般浑身一颤。
她触电般缩回手，慌乱地扯上散乱的衣物遮掩，白皙的小脸瞬间飞上两抹红晕。
“大、大爷，是你呀……”
少女挺直脊背，强压下脸颊的滚烫，挤出一个乖巧羞涩的笑脸。
旋即，她惊讶地睁大双眼：
“咦？大爷，你怎么变年轻啦？”
content_en:
"Fellow disciples, next is the grand finale of this auction - the Innate Pure Yang Holy Body!"
Hehuan Sect's underground black market.
The auctioneer's hysterical voice echoed over the empty venue.
"Once in a thousand years! The ultimate medicine!"
"Getting this cauldron and breaking through the realm in one night is like drinking from a sweet spring!"
Under the stage, countless enchantress girls from the Hehuan Sect had wild eyes.
Dozens of wolf-like consciousnesses rushed towards the huge iron cage covered by thick black cloth.
"Stop talking nonsense! Open it quickly!"
"Show me what a handsome young man you are!"
The auctioneer curled his lips and suddenly pulled off the black cloth.
The light produced by various spells instantly hit the iron cage.
The next second, the whole place suddenly fell silent.
In the iron cage, there was no young man in bright clothes and an angry horse.
There was only an old man with white beard and hair, a face full of age spots, and a stooped body.
He was standing there trembling, as if a gust of cold wind could pass away on the spot.
In the iron cage, Li Hanshan's face was dull.
"Oh my god, everyone else who traveled through time is so handsome, why should I dress like a centenarian?"
As soon as I walked through, half of my body was already buried in the loess.
I thought that this life would be over, but who knew that something even worse was to come - he was captured and used as a furnace by the crazy Hehuan Sect.
It's over.
He heard from other people who were arrested that the furnaces of the Hehuan Sect would eventually be sucked alive and fucked.
Li Hanshan looked down at his hands that looked like dry tree bark, and laughed in his heart.
The only good thing is that these wolf-like and tiger-like Hehuan sect bewitching girls are not willing to chew on this old onion, right?
However, after a brief silence.
Suddenly, a roof-shattering noise broke out from the audience!
"Oh my god! He's actually an old man who has lived to be a hundred years old and still has his vitality intact!"
A hot-looking seductress in red with scarlet eyes stood up suddenly, her voice trembling.
"Old clams grow pearls, the older they get, the mellower they become! I can't believe how terrifying the pure Yang energy in his body has settled!"
Another beautiful young woman pushed away her male favorite and licked her scarlet lips, her eyes as greedy as if she were looking at a unique treasure.
"This old man belongs to my mother! I will give you a hundred spiritual stones!"
"Five hundred spiritual stones! I want it!"
"Fart! You want to buy a top-notch talent for five hundred? I'll give you one thousand!"
"Two thousand! Whoever dares to rob me will be killed by me after leaving the black market!"
All crazy.
The eyes of these witches were scarlet, and they looked at Li Hanshan as if they were looking at a plate of unparalleled delicacies.
Even if he was skin and bones, they were eager to pounce on him immediately and devour him alive.
Li Hanshan was numb.
He thought he would be able to escape because he was old and scumbag, but who knew that these female devils had no taboos at all!
"Ten thousand spirit stones."
Just when the audience was about to draw their swords and kill each other, a charming voice suddenly exploded in the venue.
When the demon girls saw the speaker clearly, their expressions changed.
No matter how unwilling you are, you can only bow your head and give in, not even daring to fart.
Li Hanshan looked up following the voice.
But the moment he saw the buyer clearly, his soul was almost taken away.
The visitor's waist is as soft as a willow, his skin is better than snow, and his lips are like fire.
At this moment, she was leaning lazily on the railing on the second floor, holding a long-handled cigarette rod between her green-white fingers.
That peerless face that would captivate the entire country was filled with all kinds of charming charm, her red lips were blowing out smoke, and her eyes were sparkling, which could drive men all over the world crazy.
The genius of the inner sect of Hehuan Sect is Hua Nongying.
From the silent reactions of others, Li Hanshan quickly captured the terrifying status of this woman.
The ferocious look on the auctioneer's face instantly turned into flattery: "It turns out to be Senior Sister Hua! It's his good fortune that Senior Sister has taken a liking to this old tripod!"
Hua Nongying said a salty "Hmm", tapped her toes, and fell from the second floor to the iron cage like catkins.
She leaned over slightly, lifted Li Hanshan's chin with the cool cigarette rod, and smiled charmingly:
"I want this old thing~"
His tone was so frivolous that he seemed to be provokingA fun little gadget.
After saying that, she threw out a bag of spiritual stones, raised her jade hands lightly, and a piece of white silk flew out of her sleeve, tying Li Hanshan tightly.
Then she jumped into the air and pulled Li Hanshan up into the air like a chicken.
"Fuck...slow down! Old man, I have osteoporosis!"
In the wind, Li Hanshan was about to cry without tears, and felt that all the bones in his body were creaking.
After a while.
The two fell into an antique and quiet courtyard.
When the door of the room is pushed open, there are layers of pink tents, and a sweet and sweet fragrance hits the face.
It is a gentle and ecstatic place.
However, the moment Li Hanshan was thrown on the soft couch, the blood in his body froze.
His eyes were fixed on the corner of the big bed.
There, lying there was a male corpse that had been sucked into a mummified corpse! His eyes were bulging, and his death was extremely miserable!
It sucks so hard!
This witch spent a lot of money to buy him, and she was definitely going to break his bones and suck out his marrow!
"Fairy, Fairy, it's not sweet to be strong. I'm already a hundred years old..."
Li Hanshan shrank back crazily.
"Why, don't you want to?"
Hua Nongying's eyes were as charming as silk, and she moved forward a little.
She was so close that Li Hanshan could clearly smell the strange and sweet smoke, which went straight into his nose, making Li Hanshan almost unable to suppress his old brother.
"No!"
Li Hanshan held his breath, suppressed the restlessness in his heart, and calmed himself down.
"Heh."
Seeing that Li Hanshan could still hold on, Hua Nongying raised her eyebrows slightly.
She leaned closer to Li Hanshan, and gently licked his earlobe with her fragrant tongue with a hint of cool moisture.
This very provocative action instantly pushed Li Hanshan's desire to the top!
"Don't be afraid, it's very comfortable."
Hua Nongying’s slightly hoarse voice is lazy and sultry, but the content is chilling to the bone:
"Those idiots outside only know how to use force, but they don't know how to use it. The pure Yang Qi can help me cultivate the Zong Zhen Dafa. When you die, your body can still be made into a human elixir.
"With the slave family's methods, I will surely make the old man become an immortal in the bliss of the human world~"
Li Hanshan felt like he was struck by lightning.
Not even sparing the corpse? ! This woman is a pure devil!
Hua Nongying clapped her hands and summoned two maids.
“Take him to get cleaned up. "
"If you are too weak and cannot be replenished, take medicinal baths three times a day, and increase the dose by 30% each time. Let me take care of you~"
"First, let me hang up his innate pure Yang Qi. Don't let him die without my order. "
The next fifteen days.
Li Hanshan completely became a captive medicine man.
In addition to eating, drinking and having diarrhea every day, I just soaked in the wooden barrel with the strong aroma of medicine.
The elixirs in the world of immortality are extremely overbearing.
In just half a month, his shriveled body miraculously produced some vitality and blood, his cheeks became plumper, and even his wrinkles faded a lot.
Spring comes out of dead trees?
Li Hanshan couldn't laugh.
He knew very well that this was fattening the pigs before killing them. The more you feed, the worse your death will be.
Until late at night on the fifteenth day.
"Boom! "
A violent wave of spiritual energy suddenly erupted inside!
The door was blown to pieces, and Li Hanshan was knocked to the ground by the air wave, smashed to pieces.
"Damn it! Failed again! "
"If I don't cultivate Patriarch Luo's supreme secret technique, how can I compete with those bitches? ! "
Her eyes were red, her breath was disordered, and her eyes were filled with an obsession-like madness.
Her eyes were fixed on Li Hanshan, who was in shock in the corner.
His body is like electricity, and he rushes forward in an instant!
Hua Nongying pinched Li Hanshan's chin open and flicked it with one finger.
A red pill that exuded violent heat shot straight into his throat.
"Eat it! In three days, practice double cultivation with me! "
"Fairy, I can still raise you..." Li Hanshan was horrified.
"Shut up! If you keep talking nonsense, I will drain you now! "
Hua Nongying didn't give him a chance to refuse, so she walked away and closed the door.
The moment the elixir enters the stomach.
Boom——!
Li Hanshan felt as if his internal organs had been poured with hot lava, and thousands of steel needles were piercing through his meridians like crazy!
"Ah——!"
He curled up on the ground in pain, with veins popping up all over his body and twitching violently.
The severe pain that would tear his soul apart swallowed up his reason.
In the end, Li Hanshan completely passed out from the endless torture.
I don’t know how much time passed.
"Crash..."
In my ears, there was the crisp sound of running water.
As consciousness gradually recovered, Li Hanshan suddenly opened his eyes.
He entered that mysterious dream again.
Look up.
But he saw a girl dressed in white and snowy, sitting on the bluestone by the river, gently shaking her white and crystal clear legs.
Her clothes were half-undressed, one small hand covering her bare and tight belly, and she was looking at the sky in ecstasy.
Upon hearing the movement, the girl trembled like a frightened deer.
She retracted her hand as if she was electrocuted, and hurriedly pulled up the scattered clothes to cover her face. Two blushes instantly appeared on her fair face.
"S-Sir, it's you..."
The girl straightened her back, suppressed the heat on her cheeks, and forced out a sweet and shy smile.
Immediately, she opened her eyes wide in surprise:
"Huh? Uncle, why have you become younger?"
